notes.title: Dedicated Server & 'Human vs Human only' Leaderboards released with latest patch
notes.content:
The latest patch for Booster Trooper contains the awaited dedicated server.
Here is the list of all changes since Build 160:

    * Added: Dedicated Servers
    * Added: new map - Molten Rock
    * Added: "Bots Free" leaderboards only for games human vs human with no bots
    * Fixed: infinite join sound in hardcore mode
    * Fixed: several achievement detections
    * Added: Hz setting for resolutions
    * Added: password protected hosts
    * Added: sfx for spawn protect duration
    * Fixed: added missing low-textures on scrapyard
    * Improved: if reload was interrupted by grenade usage or weaponchange it will restart
    * Improved: no shooting during respawn protection
    * Improved: gfx detail option now affects physics details as well
    * Fixed: duck down accuracy check
